title: Firewalls
intro: The core sends each seat range to its firewall while that one is up, and to the next in line when it isn't. Here you see which firewall each range should take, which it takes now, and how the firewalls are.
splitIntro: Cut a network into equal ranges and share them out over the firewalls in turn: the first range goes to the first firewall with the others as backups, the second to the second, and so on. Ranges planned already stay as they are.
splitSizeHelp: The prefix length of each range, for example 24 for one range per third octet.
splitNameHelp: Optional. The ranges are numbered after it.
splitTooMany: That makes more than 256 ranges: pick a larger range size.
none: No firewalls yet. Give the firewalls the role Firewall in the inventory, then plan their ranges here.
noRangesEdit: No ranges planned yet. Add each seat range the core routes to a firewall, with its backups in order.
unread: The monitoring source can't be read right now: the ranges show their planned firewall.
moved_one: {{count}} range is not on its planned firewall
moved_other: {{count}} ranges are not on their planned firewall
name: Name
lineHelp: The first is the one the range should take, the others the failover order.
importHelp: Reads the NetBox prefixes that have the custom field floorbit_firewalls (their firewalls, in order). Each import replaces the last; ranges planned here stay.
fromPluginHelp: Change it in {{plugin}} and import again.
